Prince Coloring Book Release Party

Thu, Jun 7, 2018 · 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM · Prime 6

When
Thu, Jun 7, 2018 · 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Where
Prime 6
609 Hennepin Ave, Minneapolis
Cost
Free

Richard Moody will host this amazing event.

Meet author and illustrator, Andre Hollingsworth as he presents his debut coloring book titled Prince Coloring Book, A Tribute To Hid Musical Genius. Andre was inspired to create this book after watching a documentary about Prince’s secret gig- philanthropists. This coloring book is for all ages. It contains 28 coloring pages that reflect on each era of Prince’s career. We will celebrate Black Music Month and enjoy the Purple Sounds of Prince.

A portion of the proceeds from the Purple Paint by Numbers Art Show will go towards Connections to Independence (C2i) in Minneapolis. C2i provides unique programing and advocacy for foster care youth, ages 15-24, to prepare them for a successful transition to living independently.
